rules.statement: The court should not admit a will to probate when the propounders fail to remove suspicions created by alterations in the will, especially if those alterations are significant and could indicate lack of due execution.
rules.supporting_quote: "It was their duty if they expected to succeed in their application to remove the suspicion in regard to due execution created by the alterations in the will they sought to propound. They made no attempt whatever to do so."
